recurringKeywords: repeat repeating subscription retainer standing invoice billing schedule
hint: People who pay you every month or year, and the session packages they have bought.
catalogueHint: What you sell to members: plans that renew, and packages of sessions. Changing one never changes what existing members agreed to.
recurringHint: Invoices that are made for you on a schedule: rent, retainers, term fees, subscriptions.
emptyHint: Sign up your first member to bill them every month and give them their included visits.
noPackagesSoldHint: Sell a package of sessions to a customer. Each visit then uses one credit.
endsOnBanner: This membership is cancelled and ends on {{date}}. Until then the member can still use it.
onHold: This membership is on hold. It is not renewed and its credits cannot be used until it resumes.
onHoldUntil: This membership is on hold until {{date}}. It is not renewed and its credits cannot be used until then.
rollsOver: Carry over to the next period
expiresAtEnd: Expire at the end of the period
noInvoicesHint: Each period's invoice appears here once it has been made.
ledgerEmptyHint: Every credit given, used, given back or expired is listed here.
packageExpires: They expire {{days}} days after the sale.
planSummary: {{fee}} every {{every}}, {{credits}} credits each period, {{discount}}% off services.
endDateHint: Leave empty for a membership with no end.
invoiceTheFee: Invoice the fee now and at each renewal
invoicingOff: Invoices are not switched on, so nothing will be invoiced from here. Switch on Point of sale to bill members.
planNeedsService: This plan has no service item to invoice the fee as. Add one to the plan to bill members automatically.
packageNeedsService: This package has no service item to invoice the sale as, so it will be recorded without an invoice.
noPlansYet: There are no plans yet. Create one under Plans and packages first.
noPackagesYet: There are no packages yet. Create one under Plans and packages first.
useCreditExplain: Record a visit that is paid for with this member's credits. Credits from the membership are used first, then from the package that expires soonest.
serviceNameHint: What the visit was for. Leave empty if it does not matter.
usedPart: {{covered}} used. {{left}} more is not covered by credits and must be paid for.
adjustExplain: Add credits as goodwill, or take away credits that were given by mistake. It is recorded in the ledger with your reason.
adjustByHint: Use a minus sign to take away, for example -2.
holdExplain: While on hold the membership is not renewed and its credits cannot be used. The days on hold are added when it resumes, so the member loses nothing.
resumeOnHint: Leave empty to resume it yourself later.
frozenByUs: We are freezing it (for example for unpaid fees)
resumeExplain: The membership starts again today. The days it was on hold are added to its period.
atPeriodEnd: Cancel at the end of the period already paid for
atPeriodEndHint: The member keeps their membership and credits until the next renewal date, and is then not renewed or invoiced.
cancelNowHint: The membership ends now and any unused credits are written off.
cancelScheduled: The membership will end at the end of the period.
refundExplain: The credits left on the package are removed and the package is closed. To give the money back, make a credit note in Sales.
noPlansHint: A plan is something members pay for every month, quarter or year, with some visits included.
noPackagesHint: A package is a bundle of sessions bought once, such as 10 massages or a term of lessons.
name: Name
codeHint: A short code, such as GOLD. It cannot be changed later.
creditsPerPeriodHint: Given again at every renewal. Use 0 for none.
discountPercentHint: Members get this off services that credits do not cover.
coveredServicesHint: Separate with commas. Leave empty to cover every service.
rollover: Unused credits carry over to the next period
invoicedAsHint: The service item that appears on the invoice.
termsHint: Anything the member should agree to.
retireHint: A retired item can no longer be sold. Existing members and packages are not affected.
expiryDaysHint: Leave empty for a package that never expires.
policiesHint: How credits, renewals and reminders behave for your business.
policiesReadOnly: You can look at these, but only someone who manages plans can change them.
allowOverdrawHint: Off: a visit is only covered by the credits left, and the rest is paid for. On: the member can use credits they do not have yet.
prorate: Charge a part fee for the first period
prorateHint: Off: a membership is billed on the day it started each period. On: the first period is charged for the days left in the month, quarter or year, and members are then billed at the start of each.
catchUp: Most missed periods to bill at once
catchUpHint: If the system was off for a while, this many periods are billed. Older ones are skipped and shown for you to decide.
messageLanguageHint: Reminders to customers are written in this language.
remindersOn: Remind customers before renewals and expiry
quietHint: Reminders wait until the quiet hours are over.
scheduleCreated: {{name}} will be invoiced from now on.
dayOfMonthHint: Leave empty to use the day of the first invoice. A short month uses its last day.
orAfterCount: Or stop after this many invoices
reviewFirst: Let me look at each invoice before it is issued
reviewFirstHint: Off: the invoice is issued by itself on the day. On: it waits under Needs a look until you issue it.
dueInDaysHint: Leave empty to use the customer's terms.
noSchedulesHint: Set one up for rent, a retainer or term fees, and the invoice is made for you each period.
noSchedulesMatch: No recurring invoice matches this filter.
pauseExplain: No invoices are made while it is paused. When it starts again, the periods that passed in between are not invoiced.
scheduleResumed: The recurring invoice is running again.
endExplain: No more invoices will be made. Invoices already issued stay as they are.
runDone: Checked. Anything that was due has been invoiced.
noRunsYetHint: Each period's invoice is listed here with how it went.
nothingToReviewHint: Recurring invoices set to wait for review appear here when they are due.
failedInvoices: Invoices that could not be made
nothingFailedHint: If an invoice cannot be made, it is shown here with the reason.
discardExplain: The period starting {{date}} will be left out. This cannot be undone.
periodDiscarded: That period will not be invoiced.
issueConfirm: Issue the invoice for the period starting {{date}} now?
customerNothing: This customer has no membership or package yet.

arrearsKeywords: arrears overdue late unpaid debt owing debtors
reportsKeywords: retention churn income busy hours attendance cohort
